```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

data("instacart", package = "p8105.datasets")

department_df =
  instacart |>
  count(department, name = "n_items") |>
  slice_max(n_items, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    department = fct_reorder(department, n_items)
  )
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Top 10 departments by product entries

```{r department_bar}
plot_ly(
  data = department_df,
  x = ~n_items,
  y = ~department,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Number of product entries",
      tickformat = ",d"
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    margin = list(l = 140)
  )
```

> Source: [Instacart data](https://p8105.com/dataset_instacart.html), loaded from p8105.datasets. Each row is one product in an order. Produce has the most product entries.

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Orders by hour of day

```{r hourly_line}
order_df =
  instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, order_hour_of_day)

hourly_df =
  order_df |>
  count(order_hour_of_day, name = "n_orders") |>
  arrange(order_hour_of_day)

plot_ly(
  data = hourly_df,
  x = ~order_hour_of_day,
  y = ~n_orders,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of day",
      tickvals = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 23)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Number of orders",
      tickformat = ",d",
      rangemode = "tozero"
    )
  )
```

> Each order is counted once. This plot uses all orders in the dataset. Orders are more common during the day.

### Order size by day (5,000 sampled orders)

```{r order_size_box}
order_size_df =
  instacart |>
  count(order_id, order_dow, name = "n_products")

set.seed(123)

order_sample_df =
  order_size_df |>
  slice_sample(n = 5000) |>
  mutate(
    order_dow = factor(order_dow, levels = 0:6)
  )

plot_ly(
  data = order_sample_df,
  x = ~order_dow,
  y = ~n_products,
  color = ~order_dow,
  colors = "viridis",
  type = "box",
  boxpoints = "outliers",
  marker = list(size = 3),
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Day of week (coded 0–6)"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Products per order",
      rangemode = "tozero"
    )
  )
```

> Boxplots use 5,000 randomly sampled orders (seed 123). Day codes are kept as recorded. These results may not represent all Instacart users.
